summary: ClearSign Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing the recommencement of an at-the-market (ATM) offering via a prospectus supplement dated July 6, 2026. The company may sell up to $6,875,000 in common stock through H.C. Wainwright under a Sales Agreement from July 2025, utilizing its effective S-3 shelf registration. No price per share, premium, or close date is specified as this is a continuous equity distribution program, not a fixed-price tender or buyback. The ATM structure allows gradual capital raising with market-driven pricing. Watch for dilution overhang and trading volume; this is primarily a capital-raising mechanism, not a return of capital to shareholders.
